missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Метода' stays in the nominative case as the feminine subject. 'Особая' is the agreeing feminine adjective. The form 'метода' is a colloquial feminine variant of 'метод'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Методу' is the accusative direct object of 'применяет'. 'Старую' is the agreeing feminine accusative adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Методы' is the genitive form after 'от' to express the source of the benefit. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Методе' is the dative case required by the verb 'доверять'. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine dative. A core dative-verb pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Методой' is the instrumental case, the means used for working. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О методе' uses the prepositional form 'методе' after 'о' to express arguing about the method. A useful discussion pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Методе' is the dative form after 'благодаря', which governs the dative to express favourable cause. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Методы' is the nominative plural subject described in the book. 'Разные' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Методов' is the genitive plural required after 'несколько'. A core counting pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Метода' is nominative as the subject. 'Эффективна' is the short feminine predicate adjective agreeing with it, intensified by 'очень'.
